title: 35mm Prime Lens (Human Eye Perspective)
description: Standard 35mm focal length providing an intimate, honest, documentarian perspective that closely mimics normal human environmental vision with minimal barrel distortion.

title: 85mm Telephoto Portrait Lens
description: Classic 85mm portrait optic offering subtle facial feature compression, flattering perspective rendering without nasal exaggeration, and dramatic background blur separation.

title: Anamorphic Cinematic Optics
description: Anamorphic glass producing widescreen 2.39:1 aspect ratio, oval bokeh highlights, horizontal blue flare streaks, and characteristic dimensional cinematic depth.

title: Medium Format Camera System (Hasselblad / Fujifilm GFX)
description: Large sensor medium format imaging exhibiting immense micro-contrast, vast dynamic range, smooth tonal gradation in skin tones, and extreme rendering fidelity.

title: Ultra-Wide Angle Lens (14-24mm)
description: Exaggerated perspective with expansive field of view, pulling nearby foreground elements into prominence while pushing background horizons into vast epic scale.
